recentEventsByGoal.objective: Implement all required libsaturn library code and deliver two playable Pac-Man examples in this repo: (1) a 2D Pac-Man (no sound) and (2) a 3D Pac-Man using a VDP2 RBG0 infinite plane for the ground/background and true-perspective VDP1 distorted/scaled sprites + polygons for the 3D Pac-Man, ghosts, and maze. Done when both examples build as ISOs, are playable (movement, pellets, ghosts, win/lose), all host tests pass, and the headless harness probe plus emulator screenshots confirm they run.
